heading: What the user accepts
text:
### What the user accepts [LNRE.1.2]

`regex: false` is an opt-in constraint. Users who choose it accept:

- No regex construct anywhere in the program or the libraries it
  imports ([LNRE.3.1]).

In return they get the property in [LNRE.4]: a runtime hosting this
deployment need not link an RE2-class engine at all.
